label: before-2.0-advancement
measurement: in_process; same Bot observations, validation, simultaneous batches; no IPC/record I/O
denominators: HR/fair BIP; batter retired/fair BIP; safe >=1 base without batter out or prior fielding error/fair BIP (includes HR); runs/completed halves; ticks/completed games. Error before first safe base is scored ROE, not hit.
advancement_definition: Non-HR fair plays; physical BaseTouched only, awards excluded; runner must survive to play end. Outfield hit: grounded ball enters >=45m radius before first control (including rolling through infield), batter physically reaches first without prior error and is not fly-out; extra base means batter survives at >=2. DP/eligible fair plays with runners and <=1 prior out.
